provenance.scope: Two recorded journeys isolated from V7; native intervals, dimensions, Motion_Plan and supplied geometry are unchanged. This fixture does not establish global run correctness.
provenance.reduction: Complete supplied records for the two journeys active at the contact; original supplied network links and corridor definitions retained. Removed unrelated journey, occupancy link mappings, lane events, landmarks and display-stop catalog. Lane events for these two vehicles retain their complete supplied history.

visual_lanes.note: Separacion lateral solo visual; ancho nominal estimado de 3 m si no hay ancho OSM valido. Anchos discordantes usan el menor declarado como estimacion conservadora. Sin geometria curva efectiva, se aproxima por la cuerda entre nodos del link. No describe posiciones laterales medidas ni modifica QSim.
visual_lanes.landmarks_note: Nodos OSM del insumo guardado; contexto aproximado, no cartografia GIS verificada.
